description: Discover, validate, test, review-register and run isolated declarative extensions with fixed argv, no shell, dry-run, path containment, a lockfile gate, disable/remove/reload, and opt-in Windows Job Object containment (kill-on-close, active-process/memory limits, process-tree timeout kill). The pipeline is tested; filesystem/network sandboxing is not claimed.
requires: write access to the extension root for the lockfile and run state
checks: extension root is extensions/ or out of checkout, never a core directory
manifest schema, apiVersion, semantic version and capability id validate
entrypoint argv is an explicit list, never a shell string
entrypoint and declared read/write paths resolve inside the extension directory
every manifest declares a negative test and extension test fails when it unexpectedly succeeds
run refuses an unregistered, disabled or changed extension
dry-run executes nothing and writes no lockfile
register --accept hashes the tree and writes gypsy.lock.json atomically
disable/reload/remove are explicit, reversible or confirmed paths
opt-in Windows Job Object applies kill-on-close, active-process/memory limits and kills the process tree on timeout
non-Windows/unavailable containment falls back to direct-child execution with containment.applied=false
containment is not claimed as a filesystem or network sandbox
notes: Prototype boundary: containment is process/resource containment, not an OS sandbox; network/read-write permissions are review metadata.
